marta: hey everyone, first day! browser Okta login ok but Okta Verify won't install in WSL2 (Ubuntu). 1Password invite email shows expired link. need access to eng/onboarding and the terraform examples. who should I ask? :wave:
it-support: welcome @marta! we can resend the 1P invite or put you in a temporary new-hires vault with Drive/Repo links. tagging @samir for WSL auth tips and @kyra for shipping/invite follow-up.
samir: hi @marta  Okta Verify (mobile) won't run in WSL. options:
- use 1Password TOTP on your phone or 1Password CLI in WSL
- enable Okta email factor for a short window
- request a YubiKey shipped to you
Which would you prefer?
marta: prefer 1Password CLI in WSL so i can grab OTPs while working. please resend the invite and grant temporary drive access.
it-support: invite resent. I added you to temp new-hires vault (4h) that contains eng/onboarding and terraform examples. check spam if you don't see it.
auth-bot: Note: Device trust policies treat WSL browser sessions as unmanaged. Hardware key enrollment requires IT ticket with shipping address.
samir: quick steps to use op in WSL:
1) install 1Password app on Windows and sign in
2) in WSL install op (deb):
```
curl -sS https://downloads.1password.com/linux/keys/1password.asc | sudo apt-key add -
echo \"deb [arch=amd64] https://downloads.1password.com/linux/debian stable main\" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/1password.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install 1password-cli
```
3) run `op signin --account redwood` in WSL; open the returned URL on Windows and paste token into WSL if needed
4) get OTP: `op item get \"Okta\" --otp`
If you'd like, we can create a temporary headless item for CI or scripts.
marta: resend worked and temp vault has the terraform bits. op signin returned a URL i opened on windows and pasted back into WSL. OTP fetched fine, Okta email factor worked. thanks!
kyra: @marta please DM your phone for 2FA and let me know if you want a YubiKey shipped (yes/no + address). i'll also escalate a permanent 1Password seat if you need it now.
it-support: i'll relax the device-enroll policy on your account for 12h to avoid lockouts. re-open if anything breaks. :thumbsup:
